body: Pre-registered 2026-11-26 07:30 UTC (research_notes/Decision audits/blowup_model_test.md §A) before computing; results.json computed 07:31 UTC. L2 logistic (prior N(0,1), clip 2-60%), LOCO by start cohort. Brier M1 vs base rate: India non-fin 0.1357 vs 0.1409 (CITL +0.7pp), lenders 0.2150 vs 0.2136 (size only, loses), US 0.1194 vs 0.1306 (CITL +0.1pp, within-cohort AUC 0.69-0.75, S2 dominant). Rule (beats base on >=2/3, CITL within 3pp) -> ADOPTED. Card form C1b = max(anchored v1.5 P, model P) beats current card on all 3 panels (Brier India 0.1374->0.1357, lenders 0.2160->0.2150, US 0.1328->0.1198); CITL -4.9/-10.8/-5.2pp -> +0.7/+0.9/+1.2pp. Caveats: India within-cohort AUC only 0.56/0.60, pooled CITL passes because +-11pp cohort errors cancel; most gain = stop pulling P(blow-up) below base rate. Secondary: PEAD bottom quintile adds little on 3-yr event panel (B25 dominates). Unapplied patch tools/decision/patches/v1.6b_blowup_model_floor.patch (on top of v1.6; 61 tests pass); 9 live cards stay size 0 (UTKARSHBNK EV 1.31->1.10). Apply after Jan-Feb 2027 season with v1.6.

data.verdict: M1 adopted; card form C1b; patch unapplied

title: Blow-up probability model (class base rate + flags, logistic) out of sample: ADOPTED by prereg rule as a floor on the card's P(blow-up); solid in US, level-only in India
